# Debt Free Path

> Debt Free Path is a UK-based debt advisory and referral service helping people across England, Wales and Scotland understand their options and find the right regulated debt solution. Advice is free, impartial, and judgement-free.

Debt Free Path does not charge for advice and does not act as a lender. The site explains the main UK debt solutions in plain English (Debt Management Plans, IVAs, Debt Relief Orders, Bankruptcy, Protected Trust Deeds, and Sequestration), then refers visitors to FCA-regulated partners who can carry out a full, regulated assessment of their circumstances. Content is aimed at UK residents in problem debt and should not be treated as a substitute for regulated financial advice.

Contact: advisor@debtfreepath.co.uk | +44 7446 461601

- [Contact Us](https://debtfreepath.co.uk/contact.html): How to reach a UK-based debt specialist by phone, email, or contact form.

## Debt Solutions
- [Debt Management Plan (DMP)](https://debtfreepath.co.uk/services/debt-management-plan.html): An informal arrangement to repay unsecured debt through one affordable monthly payment.
- [Individual Voluntary Arrangement (IVA)](https://debtfreepath.co.uk/services/iva.html): A formal, legally binding agreement in England and Wales to repay debts over a fixed period, with eligibility, process, and risks explained.
- [Debt Relief Order (DRO)](https://debtfreepath.co.uk/services/debt-relief-order.html): A low-cost option in England and Wales for people with low income and few assets, including eligibility and the 12-month moratorium.
- [Bankruptcy](https://debtfreepath.co.uk/services/bankruptcy.html): How bankruptcy works in England and Wales, including the legal process, key risks, and asset implications.
- [Protected Trust Deed](https://debtfreepath.co.uk/services/protected-trust-deed.html): Scotland's formal insolvency solution allowing affordable monthly payments with remaining debt written off at the end.
- [Sequestration](https://debtfreepath.co.uk/services/sequestration.html): Scotland's equivalent of bankruptcy, providing a fresh start when debts cannot be repaid, managed by a Trustee.
